instruction: I'm playing lecture videos in VLC. The intro and credits are long, so I always want videos to start at 30 seconds in to skip them. Could you configure VLC to automatically start playback 30 seconds into any video I open?

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to set VLC's default start time to 30 seconds (start-time=30). The evaluator uses custom check_start_time__0288f685 metric to verify that start-time setting is set to 30 in VLC config file.
metadata.verification: Verified with custom function check_start_time__0288f685. Expected value: start-time=30 (30 seconds). Default is 0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VLC config file (vlcrc) from appropriate OS-specific location
Metric correctly parses start-time setting from config file and compares against expected value of 30 seconds
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement (start-time=30) specified in the instruction
Expected value is semantically correct: 30 seconds matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are saved to disk before verification
Data flow is correct: getter extracts config file path, metric parses start-time value, comparison logic works correctly
Proper error handling for missing files and parsing errors
